Only active:true products are sold. cost_cents is the delivered supplier cost from the Shopify export (2026-09-21) - our suppliers already include freight in it, so freight_cents stays 0 and exists only for a supplier that bills freight separately. products.name: Thorvin Kelp
products.description:
Thorvin Kelp is the finest Certified Organic nutrient source on the market today. Kelp contains a range of minerals and vitamins often deficient in soils and feed and has a broad array of uses in agriculture and product formulations.

Kelp is a valuable renewable resource for animal health. The most valuable kelps grow in cold, mineral-rich waters and grow more slowly. These kelps collect minerals, vitamins, enzymes, amino acids and other beneficial bioactive properties. Thorvin carefully captures and preserves these nutrients using the most effective drying and storing methods in order to deliver the most consistently effective products derived from these kelps.

For animal feeding programs, average intake levels on a free choice basis (per head per day) are as follows: Livestock: 1 to 4 ounces Dogs: ½ to 1 teaspoon per animal per day Cats: ¼ teaspoon per animal per day Poultry: 1-2% of feed ration. 

*Please DO NOT feed Thorvin Kelp directly to Rabbits. The level of iodine in the kind of kelp Thorvin provides is very high. While for many animals this is a benefit, rabbits are sensitive to iodine.

**Note that because this product is bagged in a mill which handles organic grains, it may not be completely free of small pieces of organic grain.
